Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Home Deptt. Govt. Civil Secrt. Lk
Counsel for Applicant :- Vivek Kumar Verma,Arun Prakash Verma,Shalini Gupta
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
Despite service of notice, no one appeared on behalf of the complainant.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.205 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Baghauli, District Hardoi.
3. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report with the allegation that the applicant had enticed the daughter of the informant.

In the statement under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C.,
the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that she had gone out of her own freewill Pintu vs State Of U.P Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Home ... on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72008777/

entities.text: freewill Pintu vs State Of U.P Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: and physical relations were also formed.
The tentative age of the victim is 19 years.

4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.
5. Considering the statements under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C., prima facie, she did not support the prosecution story and even the medical report does not support the prosecution case coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 22.08.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Pintu be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
